Sandbox_Woodcutting_damageBaseMultiplier: Multiplies tree damage at level 0, before per-level scaling.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_damagePerLevel_toolt: Additional damage per Woodcutting level. 0.15 = +15%% per level.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_damageMaxMultiplier_: Upper cap for the total tree-damage multiplier.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_oneHitLevelThreshold: At or above this Woodcutting level, trees fall in one swing. Set to 11 or higher to disable this entirely. 0 means every tree falls in one swing from the start.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_oneHitTreeDamage_too: TreeDamage used once the one-hit threshold is reached.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_onlyForAxes_tooltip: If enabled, damage scaling applies to axes only.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_axeXpPerHit_tooltip: Axe XP awarded for each tree hit made with an axe. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_treeFelledXp_tooltip: Bonus Woodcutting XP when a tree is fully cut down. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_axeXpOnTreeFelled_to: Bonus Axe XP when a tree is fully cut down with an axe. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_bushRemovedXp_toolti: Woodcutting XP awarded for clearing a bush. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_cumulatedForagingAnd: Minimum combined levels required for fruit extras.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_FruitTreeExtra_toolt: Lower is more likely. Adjusted by abundance and skills.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_Winter_tooltip: Extras chance during winter. Lower is more likely.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_Pinecone_tooltip: Chance to get a pinecone. Lower is more likely.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_PineTreeExtra_toolti: Extra loot on pine-like trees. Lower is more likely.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_Log_tooltip: Chance to get an extra log.
Sandbox_Woodcutting_TreeBranch_tooltip: Chance to get an extra tree branch.
